title: Account
description: What somebody is owed by the system that bills them: a plan, a credit balance, and the day the cycle turns over. Not an actor and not an organisation — the actor is the person who owns it, named here by key. One person can be billed by more than one system, and each one keeps its own account.

id.description: The record's own id in the system that holds it.

owner.description: The wallet, handle, or id under localIds of the person billed. One account per person per system.

plan.description: Which plan is in force, in the words of the system that sells it. Free text: the catalogue of plans belongs to the seller and changes without the shape changing.

creditsBalance.description: Credits left to spend. Whole credits, never fractions, because a half-spent credit is not a thing anybody can sell.

cycleRenewsAt.description: When the next cycle starts and the balance is refilled. Stated rather than computed from the plan, so a cycle moved by hand stays moved.
